headline: She doesn't need a phone.
sub: One shared ring shows the whole family when Gran was last visited.
content:
GranWatch in one breath: a colour ring around Gran's photo that the whole family sees at once. Green when someone's been recently. Slowly turning as the weeks pass. Red when it's been too long — and back to green the moment anyone visits.

She doesn't need a phone, an app or a password. The family carries it for her.

Free for the whole family, on the App Store and Google Play. Everything you need to know on one page: granwatch.app/learn
notes: Tier 2 leads launch week. Watch: link clicks to /learn.
